page.layout: Running head at top, left and centre; page number 360 at top left. Below it, a heading in two lines, centred. Then the label "Septem:" in italic. Under the label, a figure of musical rest signs: a left column of staves and a right column of stacked signs. Below the figure, two indented paragraphs in italic, then the catchword "DE" at the lower right.
page.notes: The figure between "Septem:" and the first paragraph is a set of seven musical rest signs: the left column shows staves with rests drawn in the lines, the right column shows the same signs stacked vertically.
